During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''peace initiative''' was created and approved by the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Senate]]. The motion for a diplomatic end to the war was presented to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], but was shot down in light of a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|recent Confederate terrorist attack]] and the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of Separatist [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]].

==History==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] convened an emergency session to debate the true cost of the war. Several senators, such as [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]] and [[Mot-Not Rab/Legends|Mot-Not Rab]], argued to keep the war going, with [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]],<ref name="HOBS" /> the Senator of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="Fact139" /> offering to protect the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from bankruptcy by opening new credit lines with major financial institutions&mdash;a proposal molded into a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill]] by Saam. Their militaristic stance was also supported by [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]],<ref name="HOBS" /> the Senator of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="HOBS" /><ref name="Clone-Burtoni" />

Pacifist senators like [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] opposed these views, with Amidala stating that moral responsibility of the war also had to be considered. This triggered accusations of betrayal,<ref name="HOBS" /> forcing [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]]<ref name="Amedda-DB" /> [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] to interrupt the meeting and postpone it.<ref name="HOBS" />
